newsitem.title: UK: Ldn silver fixed lower, gold awaits OTC expiry.
newsitem.headline: Ldn silver fixed lower, gold awaits OTC expiry.

text.p: SILVER - Fixed at 472.40 cents from 474.25. Glued to $4.70-$4.74 range, although falls expected after OTC options expiry.
GOLD - Steady above $341.00, but OTC expiry may trigger falls after New York opens. Quoted at $341.00/$341.30.
PALLADIUM - Down $3.05 at $156.25/$157.25 but losses seen limited while Russia supply situation remains unresolved.
